title: Riso zine page, “stuck indoors 2”
lede: A zine page about VHS films, printed in fluorescent pink and blue: collage, text, and drawing on separate layers that overprint into violet and do not quite align.
summary: Zine page in pink and blue riso ink, with collage layers that overprint and misregister.

creator.name: Unknown. The Flickr uploader, themostinept, does not say who made the zine.

evidence.note: Viewed the 704 × 1024 px Flickr “large” file, a phone photograph of one page. The Flickr description is “stuck indoors 2”. The zine’s title and maker are not stated.

styles.note: Two inks, pink and blue, overprint into violet, and the layers are visibly misregistered.

context: Posted on Flickr under CC BY-SA 2.0 by themostinept. It is not clear that the uploader made the zine, so the rights of the printed work are unknown.
observed: The page uses fluorescent pink and a mid blue on off-white paper, and no black.
A pink rectangle with the word “VHS” sits under a blue drawing of a VHS case and a deer. Where they cross, the color is violet.
Blue text bars at the top are knocked out of the ink, and the pink layer sits a few millimeters off from the blue.
Blue areas are grainy and uneven, with streaks in the large photographic areas.
interpretation: The page shows nearly every riso trait at once: two inks, overprint mixing, grain, and misregistration, used for a personal, collaged zine.
borrow: Put text in knocked-out bars of a single ink, and let a second ink block run under it slightly off register.

rights.statement: Photo posted CC BY-SA 2.0 by themostinept. The zine’s author is not named, so the printed work is treated as in copyright. Link only.
